title: Boron-doped scandium clusters B@Scn−1−/0/+ with n = 2–13: uncovering the smallest endohedrally doped cages
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34718-34732
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06541G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Bao-Ngan Nguyen-Ha, Nguyen Minh Tam, My Phuong Pham-Ho, Minh Tho Nguyen
A comprehensive study using density functional theory investigates the pure Scn+/0/− and doped Scn−1B+/0/− clusters with n = 1–13 in three charged states: the smallest endohedrally doped cages.
